---
title: "City2Graph · Map an OD matrix"
---

::: {.lead}
Turn an external origin-destination flow matrix plus a zones layer into a spatial
graph, with edges between zone centroids weighted by flow. Mirrors the
[Mobility panel](../../../panels/city2graph/mobility.qmd).
:::

Needs a **zones** object (polygons) with a unique ID column, loaded with **Load
File** in [Import urban data](data.qmd), and an **OD matrix** CSV of flows
between those same zone IDs.

## 1. Set the zones

Set the **Zones Object** and the **Zone ID Column** (`zone_id`, for instance).
The IDs there have to match the ones in the matrix.

![Selecting the zones object and ID column.](../../../assets/guides/city2graph/06-zones.png)

## 2. Load the OD matrix

Set the **OD Matrix Path** and the **Matrix Type**. **Adjacency** needs nothing
further; **Edgelist** also needs the **Source**, **Target** and **Weight**
columns.

![Loading the OD matrix and mapping its columns.](../../../assets/guides/city2graph/06-load-matrix.png)

## 3. Build the OD graph

**Threshold** drops weak flows and **Directed** decides whether the result keeps
direction. Edges are drawn between zone centroids and weighted by flow.

![The OD flow graph between zone centroids.](../../../assets/guides/city2graph/06-od-graph.png)
